content: Iawe God Elaia wadene uboo odene aleide
Walama kerauda os bedewe Iawe God Elaia wadepiposidepio wiriwiritoto asiasi odepie uboo alepi, Elaia ita Elaisa bola debama Gilgalwae nomone antoie.

Elaia me diene wanase, “E mape wanempa, Iawe God dianena ne bola debama Betel bedewe anteapa.” Tane Elaisa sipoasane wanase, “Ulaipa Iawe God wanwankasalala ebowe ita do e eboawo ne sauantedina e mai eepa, dia.” Sa baiwa mo iane Betelwa anton.

Ita Betel bedewe peroweta sape waimoie ita mo wimone Elaisa diane waienase, “E ateiten ba, dia, ande Iawe God e debamaa manawo wadepie alepia baiwaleide?” Elaisa sipoamone wanase, “Oa, ne atenten tane e mai gagalowa wana.”

Tane Elaia me mampe wanase, “Elaisa, e mape wanempa. Iawe God ne dianena bola debama Ieriko bedewe anteapa.” Tane Elaisa sipoasane wanase, “Ulaipa Iawe God wanwankasalala ebowe ita do e eboawo ne sauantedina e mai eepa, dia.” Sa baiwa mo iane bola Ierikowa anton.

Peroweta Ieriko bedewe wanwanlala wimone Elaisa waitarasane waienase, “E ateiten ba, dia, ande Iawe God e debamaa manawo wadepie alepia baiwaleide?” Elaisa sipoamone wanase, “Oa, ne atenten tane e mai gagalowa wana.”

Ita Elaia me mampe wanase, “Elaisa, e mape wanempa. Iawe God ne dianena esa Ioadanwa iape anteapa.” Tane Elaisa sipoasane wanase, “Ulaipa Iawe God wanwankasalala ebowe ita do e eboawo ne sauantedina e mai eepa, dia.” Ita mo nata awodea antoiena.
Ita peroweta uduudu bedeuwo 50 mo do antoiena. Elaia ita Elaisa Ioadan esawa tampe nomone eneiena, ita peroweta sa uduudu 50 nomone eseanama enane emontoie.
Ita Elaia garawa onapea wadenaubene nukulene mampe esa epen. Ita esa meba rialene on ita sen deneuwe antono me Elaisa nata nomone dogo makowa asiasi nawane anton.

Mo antone waiwa dauwo wimone Elaia Elaisa diene wanase, “Dima e baia dewasapa meneedia dianea ita aupe Iawe God ne wadaposinepio odape anteapa.” Ita Elaisa sipoasane wanase, “Ne menanede e mukaa osowesae
debamasae neawo e aupaa wadape peroweta uwau apanawa segantapa.”
Tane Elaia leusane wanase, “E dewa debama iririwaiten. Ne ewaneano Iawe God wadaposinepio odape antepino, tauma e dima iririwa waana wadaa. Naita dia, sa ide, dia.”

Ita mo gagalontoie antoio tauwadea oas turaka teineia osowe ia idie bumedia do seganton. Ita oas sa Elaia ita Elaisa sawanauwointa nomone anton, ita Iawe God Elaia wiriwiritoto bedewainta wadenposideno uboo odene alen.

Elaisa dewa ema ewene mukalene wanase, “Ne mamana! Ne mamana! Ne Israelwa turakau oas mampe teiteinala apanawa do ewamodina!” Sape me Elaia mai osowe ewapona. Me nuaparewa eueuwa dewasane garawa onapea sioleno kepawa nata seganton.
Tane Iawe God Elaia wadenposideno uboo odene aleidio garawa onapea dogo osowe noseno Elaisa waden.
Ita me alene esa Ioadan waiwe enen.
Ita me Elaia garawa onapea noseno wadena mampe esa epene mukalene wanase, “Iawe Elaia Godiwa naepe?” Me epe wane esa epeno einpue awopawa ituno nawene alen.
Tane peroweta Ieriko bedewe wanwanlala eseanama enane dima segalena ewane waienase, “Elaia mukawa tauma Elaisa osowelen!” Ita mo antone me donsane danawe dogo osowe dunentoiena.

Mo waienase, “No apana mukamukaua uduudu 50 mape wainitana. E wawo no ane e debamaa banusata. Dauwa Iawe God Aleupa me awanene alene wadi da osowe itun, ba bola da nua bedewe itun.” Tane Elaisa diamone wanase, “Dia, e mai aitana.”
Tane mo me kainokaino iririsaio malalene wanase, “Sa ide aitana.” Apana sa uduudu 50 Elaia banusapua baiwa antone laio walama natadea dialen ita me mai donsapona, dia.
Tane Elaisa bola Ieriko bedewe wandie, ita mo wimoieno me diamone wanase, “Ne dialena, mai aitana.”

footnotes.text: 2.9 Israel apanawa dewau ema epe: Mo mambu bolepio aupe me puraiwawa obampa odantopue otepu. Tane oto tautuwa puraiwa osowesapie otepi. Epe rua, Elaisa Elaia iririsadia me mukawa debama wanepio aupawa wadepie peroweta uau apanawa segalepi.
2.13 Eueuwa ema Elaisa Elaia aupawa wadena eueuwa. Me Elaia mukawa ita ginasawa osowelepi (ewana 1 Kin 19.19).
